jay.description: AI assistant for sales teams — Solo developer
jay.fullDescription: Jay is a conversational AI assistant accessible via WhatsApp that enables professionals to manage their CRMs and calendars through voice. Users send a voice note describing what they want to do, and Jay transcribes, analyzes, and automatically executes the corresponding actions in connected systems. Supports 6 major CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho, Odoo, TeamLeader), calendar and email integrations.

nicolas-steinberg.fullDescription: Portfolio website for a luxury hospitality consultant. Premium and refined design reflecting the luxury world. Smooth scroll animations, impeccable Lighthouse scores (97/100 performance, 100/100 SEO). Integration of custom strategic tools.

rdp-glass.fullDescription: Complete web application for a B2B glass packaging distributor. Admin dashboard, product catalog management, integrated blog system, and client interface optimized for conversion.

cost.question: How much does a website cost?
cost.answer: Every project is unique. Contact me for a free, no-obligation custom quote.

timeline.question: What are the timelines?
timeline.answer: Landing page: 1-2 weeks. Showcase website: 2-3 weeks. Redesign: 2-3 weeks. Web application: 1-2 months.

hosting.question: Is hosting included?
hosting.answer: I offer both options: I can manage hosting for you, or advise you on doing it yourself.

autonomy.question: Can I update the site myself?
autonomy.answer: Depending on your needs, I can integrate a CMS (content management system) so you're fully autonomous.

technologies.question: What technologies do you use?
technologies.answer: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript — modern, performant, and maintainable technologies.

location.question: Do you travel for meetings?
